siteCode.title: Site part
siteCode.description: ES module source exporting `start` and `handle`, as in sites/betterwork.js.

spec.title: Spec
spec.description: The spec reader's output (<spec>.spec.json): columns, rules and sample rows.

testLimit.title: Test limit
testLimit.description: Run the samples' requests plus this many other follow-ups. Leave empty for a full run.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel requests for this run. Leave empty to use the site part's own config, set from Dapi's measurements.

robotsOverride.title: Fetch despite robots.txt
robotsOverride.description: Only with the user's approval, when the investigation found no allowed route. Overridden requests are counted in the report and marked in their evidence.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: run: extract with the site part. probe: check how the site answers Apify's servers.

requests.title: Probe requests
requests.description: probe mode: [{ label, url, method, payload, headers, expect }]

pace.title: Pace test requests
pace.description: probe mode: other records' detail requests, fetched 1, 3 and 6 at a time to find the site's sweet spot

countryCode.title: Proxy country
countryCode.description: probe mode: country for proxy IPs, e.g. KE
